theorems.statement: ∀ (E₁ E₂ E₃ : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] [NormedAddCommGroup E₃] [NormedSpace ℝ E₃] (m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : E₁ → E₂) (h : E₂ → E₃) (U : Set E₁) (V : Set E₂), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → IsOpen V → MapsTo f U V → (1 ≤ m ∨ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U ∨ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h V) → ContDiffOn ℝ m f U → (∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ m h V → (∀ K : Set E₂, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ m (h ∘ f) U ∧ ∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h ∘ f) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h ∘ f) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
